decks.title: Basics
decks.description: Welcome friend :-) This is a deck of QuickStart cards. Each one is a little piece of music with one new idea in its code. Press play to hear it, then change the code and play again. When you're ready, move on to the next card...

cards.title: Your First Note
cards.blurb: Use play to make a beep. Change 60 to a bigger number for a higher note or a smaller number for a lower note.
cards.code: play 60

cards.title: Change Synth
cards.blurb: Change synth with use_synth to change the character of the sound. Use options like release: to change the duration.
cards.code:
use_synth :chiplead
play 72, release: 0.2

cards.title: Lower and Longer Synth
cards.blurb: Let's try a different synth, drop 12 notes down (an octave) and give it a longer release duration.
cards.code:
use_synth :fm
play 72 - 12, release: 3

cards.title: A Little Tune
cards.blurb: To make a melody you need to add sleeps between the notes you play. See if you can hear the last two ring together as there is no sleep.
cards.code:
play :e4
sleep 0.25
play :g4
sleep 0.25
play :b4
play :e3

cards.title: A Chord
cards.blurb: Chords are easy to play too.
cards.code:
use_synth :piano
play (chord :e4, :minor)

cards.title: A Beat
cards.blurb: Four bars of boots and cats.
cards.code:
4.times do
  sample :bd_haus, lpf: 80
  sleep 0.25
  sample :sn_dolf, hpf: 110
  sleep 0.25
end

cards.title: Roll the Dice
cards.blurb: Pick random percussive slices from any sample. Change the random seed, change the choices.
cards.code:
use_random_seed 30

16.times do
  sample :loop_amen, onset: pick
  sleep 0.125
end

cards.title: Roll the Dice again
cards.blurb: Different seeds create different random outcoms. All repeatable and re-usable.
cards.code:
use_random_seed 50

16.times do
  sample :guit_em9, onset: pick
  sleep 0.125
end

cards.title: Re-use dice throws
cards.blurb: Use the same random stream with any sample.
cards.code:
use_random_seed 30

16.times do
  sample :guit_em9, onset: pick
  sleep 0.125
end

cards.title: Synth Pads
cards.blurb: Combine long release times with other opts like cutoff for expressive pads.
cards.code:
use_synth :prophet
play :e1, release: 8, cutoff: 80

decks.title: Synths
decks.description: Trigger, manipulate and expressively control synths with code.

cards.title: Slow Bloom
cards.blurb: Fade in with attack and fade out with release. Stretch them and a note becomes a pad.
cards.code:
use_synth :prophet
play :e2, attack: 2, release: 4

cards.title: Open the Filter
cards.blurb: Control the brightness and fuzz of the sound by filtering the high frequencies.
cards.code:
use_synth :tb303
play :e2, cutoff: 60
sleep 0.5
play :e2, cutoff: 90
sleep 0.5
play :e2, cutoff: 120

cards.title: Rave Stab
cards.blurb: Play multiple notes like chords at the same time to add the sounds together.
cards.code:
use_synth :supersaw
play (chord :e3, :minor)

cards.title: Glide
cards.blurb: Change and slide most opts using control. note_slide lets you set a slide duration.
cards.code:
use_synth :prophet
s = play :e2, sustain: 4, note_slide: 1
sleep 1
control s, note: :b2
sleep 1
control s, note: :e3

cards.title: Wobble
cards.blurb: The mod synths flip between two pitches automatically. Instant wobble.
cards.code:
use_synth :mod_dsaw
play :e2, mod_range: 12, release: 3

decks.title: FX
decks.description: Effects that transform any sound. Wrap your code in one and hear it change.

cards.title: Cathedral
cards.blurb: Wrap a sound in reverb and it gets a room. room: 1 is a cathedral.
cards.code:
with_fx :reverb, room: 1 do
  sample :perc_bell, rate: 0.8
end

cards.title: Dub Echo
cards.blurb: Echoes repeat in time. phase sets how far apart, decay how long they ring.
cards.code:
with_fx :echo, phase: 0.25, decay: 6 do
  play :e5, release: 0.1
end

cards.title: Krush
cards.blurb: Krush and distort any sound such as this guitar sample.
cards.code:
sample :guit_e_fifths
sleep 2
with_fx :krush do
  sample :guit_e_fifths
end

cards.title: The Chopper
cards.blurb: The slicer FX gates the sound on and off in time. Use it to turn a chord into a rhythm.
cards.code:
with_fx :slicer, phase: 0.125 do
  sample :guit_em9
end

cards.title: FX Inside FX
cards.blurb: Here the sample runs through the echo and then through reverb in a chain. You can chain many FX together this way.
cards.code:
with_fx :reverb, room: 0.9 do
  with_fx :echo, phase: 0.375 do
    sample :tabla_ghe3
  end
end

decks.title: Live Loops
decks.description: Live Loops play at the same time. Each one is a loop with its own timing, rhythm and score. Layer simple loops for complex sounds.

cards.title: Kick
cards.blurb: Start with a four-to-the-floor kick.
cards.code:
live_loop :kick do
  sample :bd_haus
  sleep 1
end

cards.title: Hi-Hat
cards.blurb: Offbeat hats riding on top.
cards.code:
live_loop :hats do
  sample :drum_cymbal_closed, amp: 0.5
  sleep 0.5
end

cards.title: Snare
cards.blurb: A backbeat on the 2 and the 4.
cards.code:
live_loop :snare do
  sleep 1
  sample :sn_dolf
  sleep 1
end

cards.title: Bass
cards.blurb: A rolling acid bassline underneath.
cards.code:
live_loop :bass do
  use_synth :tb303
  play :e1, release: 0.4, cutoff: 80
  sleep 0.5
end

cards.title: Chords
cards.blurb: Slow warm pads to fill it out.
cards.code:
live_loop :chords do
  use_synth :prophet
  c = (chord :e3, :minor)
  play c, release: 3, cutoff: rrand(70, 130)
  sleep 4
end

cards.title: Lead
cards.blurb: A random topline over the top with the saw synth.
cards.code:
live_loop :lead do
  use_synth :saw
  n = (scale :e5, :minor_pentatonic).choose
  play n, release: 0.2
  sleep 0.25
end

decks.title: Hotswap
decks.description: If you use the same live loop name it doesn't create a new live loop - it hot swaps the code in time with the beat.

cards.title: Start the Loop
cards.blurb: This is the loop :groove. Run the next cards and the same loop changes to them, live.
cards.code:
live_loop :groove do
  sample :bd_haus
  sleep 1
end

cards.title: Add a Snare
cards.blurb: Same :groove with a backbeat now. Run it and the drums switch to the new code without missing a beat.
cards.code:
live_loop :groove do
  sample :bd_haus
  sleep 0.5
  sample :sn_dolf
  sleep 0.5
end

cards.title: Double Time
cards.blurb: sleep 0.25 is four hits a beat.
cards.code:
live_loop :groove do
  sample :bd_haus
  sleep 0.25
end

cards.title: Drop a Melody
cards.blurb: Slip a note into the loop alongside the drum.
cards.code:
live_loop :groove do
  sample :bd_haus
  play :e4, release: 0.2
  sleep 0.5
end

cards.title: Silence
cards.blurb: Putting stop in a live_loop causes it to stop running.
cards.code:
live_loop :groove do
  stop
  sample :bd_haus
  sleep 1
end

decks.title: Scope Art
decks.description: Draw with sound! Open the scope and pick the Lissajous view. The left speaker moves the beam sideways, the right moves it up and down - pure sine waves draw the cleanest shapes.

cards.title: A Line of Light
cards.blurb: One sine panned centre sends the same wave to both speakers, so the beam sweeps a diagonal line. Try pan: -1 to lay it flat.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, sustain: 4

cards.title: Draw a Circle
cards.blurb: The same note hard left and hard right, a quarter of a cycle apart. Sideways and up-down a quarter turn out of step is a circle.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, pan: -1, sustain: 4
play :a4, pan: 1, sustain: 4, phase_offset: 0.25

cards.title: Squash the Circle
cards.blurb: Offsets between 0 and 0.25 tilt and squash the circle into ellipses. Try 0.05, 0.125 and 0.2.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, pan: -1, sustain: 4
play :a4, pan: 1, sustain: 4, phase_offset: 0.125

cards.title: Spiral In
cards.blurb: A circle drawn by a fading note shrinks as it fades. Watch it spiral into the dark.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, pan: -1, attack: 1, release: 6
play :a4, pan: 1, attack: 1, release: 6, phase_offset: 0.25

cards.title: Figure of Eight
cards.blurb: An octave apart is a 2:1 ratio - the classic figure of eight. Swap the two pans to flip it on its side.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a3, pan: -1, sustain: 4
play :a4, pan: 1, sustain: 4, phase_offset: 0.25

cards.title: Tie a Knot
cards.blurb: A 3:2 ratio weaves a knot. hz_to_midi keeps the ratio exact so the knot holds still - try 275 (5:4) or 293.33 (4:3) too.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play hz_to_midi(220), pan: -1, sustain: 4
play hz_to_midi(330), pan: 1, sustain: 4, phase_offset: 0.25

cards.title: Tumbling Knot
cards.blurb: A fifth on a keyboard is almost - but not quite - 3:2, so the same knot slowly tumbles forever. That tiny gap is tuning made visible.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a3, pan: -1, sustain: 8
play :e4, pan: 1, sustain: 8

cards.title: Set it Spinning
cards.blurb: Detune one side by a fraction of a hertz and the shape rolls from line to circle and back, once every five seconds. Less detune, slower spin.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, pan: -1, sustain: 8
play hz_to_midi(440.2), pan: 1, sustain: 8

cards.title: Every Shape at Once
cards.blurb: Slide one side two octaves and the figure morphs through every ratio on the way - lines, eights, knots and tangles.
cards.code:
use_synth :sine
play :a4, pan: -1, sustain: 6
s = play :a3, pan: 1, sustain: 6, note_slide: 6
control s, note: :a5

cards.title: Spin it Live
cards.blurb: A live loop nudging phase_offset a little further each beat spins the figure like a coin. Change steps: to spin faster or slower.
cards.code:
live_loop :spin do
  p = (line 0, 1, steps: 64).tick
  play :a4, pan: -1, sustain: 0.25
  play :a4, pan: 1, sustain: 0.25, phase_offset: p
  sleep 0.25
end
